4.episodeTitle: Two Unbeatens, One Commish Benching Himself
4.teaser: Team Nelson drops 187.5 with 46.5 on the bench, Say whatttt bulldozes by 54, and Lorde Commish wins despite his own lineup.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: WELCOME TO BLOODSPORT CENTER! Week 4 is in the books, and Team Nelson just put up 187.5 points. The highest score in the league. Four and OH, baby!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: And Kirk Cousins scored 46.5 on their bench. They left more points at quarterback on the pine than some teams got from their entire starting backfield.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: That's the scariest part! The Nelson Machine is so loaded it can bench a 46.5-point quarterback and STILL win by 38!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Or it started the wrong quarterback and nobody noticed because the other team couldn't stop the bleeding. Both things can be true, Mike.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Don't ruin this for me, Tasha. We've got two undefeated teams, a Commish who needs supervision, and a basement getting crowded. Let's GO!

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Kicking it off: Team Nelson 187.5, phillip's Perfect Team 149.5. Tetairoa McMillan with 38, Tyler Shough with 37, Chuba Hubbard with 35.5. Nelson moves to 4-0!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Phillip got 43 from Kyle Monangai and 32 from Jonathan Taylor, then got a flat zero from Ladd McConkey. 'Perfect Team' is now 2-2 and on a two-game skid.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Lorde Commish 120.5, GetBackGang 104.5! The Commish gets his first win of the year behind 31.5 from Jordan Love.

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: GetBackGang started Chris Boswell for zero points while Matt Gay scored 16 on the bench. They lost by 16. You can do that math yourself, I'm tired.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Say whatttt 175, Northeast Winners 121! C.J. Stroud drops 42 and Say whatttt stays perfect at 4-0!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: More on that crime scene later. Team epps 156.5, Heavy Gewts 116.5. Dak Prescott with 40, Javonte Williams with 38.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: And Heavy Gewts had been owning this series 5-1! Saquon Barkley gave them ONE point. One!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Moravia RD MMG 131, Tomfootballteam 117. That's the closest game of the week, which tells you what kind of week it was.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: The Conqueror 182.5, Team Ayers 141! Bryce Young with 44.5, Kenneth Walker III with 42. CONQUERED!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Team Ayers got 49 from Jared Goff and 34 from CeeDee Lamb and still lost by 41.5. They're 0-3. Sometimes the universe just says no.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: And finally, Yall suck 177.5, The GOAT 152.5. Joe Burrow went NUCLEAR. Hold that thought.

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: The GOAT scored 152.5 and lost. Third straight loss. The name is aging like milk. Lul Daddy was on bye and is the only team that didn't lose ground this week by default.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Game of the Week! Moravia RD MMG takes down Tomfootballteam by 14 in a SLUGFEST!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Fourteen points. In this league, that qualifies as a nail-biter. Everyone else was busy getting run over.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Brock Purdy went off for 44 for Tomfootballteam! He tried to carry that whole roster on his back!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: And the Cowboys D/ST answered with negative 2. Purdy built the house, the defense set it on fire.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Moravia had balance, though. Lamar Jackson 32.5, Rhamondre Stevenson 22.5, James Cook III 20.5. That's how you close it out!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Fun footnote: Tomfootballteam benched Tank Bigsby's 12.5 for Kendre Miller's 4.5. Start Bigsby and they still lose by 6. Moravia leads this series 3-0 and has won three straight.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: The Moravia Steamroller is ROLLING at 3-1!

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Ooooh, viewers, cover the kids' eyes. Say whatttt 175, Northeast Winners 121. A FIFTY-FOUR point beatdown!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Northeast Winners. A team name that is now legally a lie.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Deshaun Watson gave them 30.5, Christian McCaffrey 21, Romeo Doubs 20. Respectable! And then the lineup fell off a cliff!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Kalif Raymond started at wide receiver and scored one point. Malik Washington sat on the bench with 9.5. Their bench had 81 points total, Mike. Eighty-one.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: 81 on the BENCH?! That's not a bench, that's a second team that never got to play!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: And the brutal part: Say whatttt got 3.5 from Ja'Marr Chase and still won by 54. Northeast Winners lost to a team that was playing with one hand tied behind its back.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: C.J. Stroud 42, Quinshon Judkins 26.5, Sam LaPorta 23. Say whatttt said 'say what' and then said NOTHING ELSE. Just violence.

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Say whatttt also benched Jake Bates' 18 for Evan McPherson's 5.5. They're making mistakes and going 4-0 anyway. Rude.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Player of the Week! Joe Burrow, 52 POINTS for Yall suck! FIFTY-TWO! Somebody check that man's arm for a warranty!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Highest single-player score of the week. Yall suck is 3-1 and the team name is now just a message to the rest of us.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Shout-out to Jared Goff with 49 for Team Ayers too. In a loss. Pour one out.

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Now for the Dud of the Week: Cowboys D/ST, negative 2 points for Tomfootballteam. In a 14-point loss.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: NEGATIVE! You'd have been better off starting an empty slot! At least zero doesn't hurt you!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: For the record, the Lions D/ST also posted negative 2 for Team Ayers. It was a bad week to trust a defense.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: And now, the Bench Blunder. And oh, this one hits different, because it's the man in charge. LORDE COMMISH!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: The Commish benched T.J. Hockenson, who scored 26.5, and started Cade Otton, who scored 8. That's 18.5 points left on the bench. The biggest blunder in the league.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: The man runs the league and can't run his own tight end slot!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: He also started Brandon Aubrey, who scored zero. So that's two lineup spots producing a combined 8 points. And he still won by 16.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: That's the Lorde Commish Paradox! Win the game, lose the lineup! Somebody impeach this man... after he gets his second win.

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Credit where due: he beat GetBackGang. Which is a bit like congratulating someone for beating the vending machine.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Standings time! At the top, two undefeated monsters: Team Nelson and Say whatttt, both 4-0!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Team Nelson has 686 points for, most in the league. Say whatttt is at 576.5. Same record, very different levels of terror.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Right behind them at 3-1: The Conqueror, Yall suck, and Moravia RD MMG on a three-game heater! The Conqueror has 661 points for, they are NOT messing around!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Sliding: phillip's Perfect Team on two straight losses at 2-2, and The GOAT on three straight at 1-3. The GOAT has 553 points for, which is more than Moravia, and they're 1-3. Brutal luck.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Eight playoff spots, and right now the cutoff is a logjam at 2-2 with phillip's Perfect Team, Heavy Gewts, and Team epps!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Now the part people actually care about: the race to avoid last place. GetBackGang is 0-4, the only team without a win after four games.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: GET BACK, GANG! Get back to the drawing board! And Team Ayers is right there at 0-3 with the fewest points for in the league at 395!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Lorde Commish and The GOAT at 1-3 aren't safe either. And Lul Daddy is 1-2 with 346 points in three games. That punishment is very much in play for a lot of people.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Next week's main event: Yall suck at The Conqueror! 3-1 versus 3-1! Burrow's crew walks into the Conqueror's house!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: All-time series is tied 2-2. Someone breaks the tie and someone falls to 3-2 behind the undefeated teams.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Also keep an eye on The GOAT at Team Nelson. 1-3 against 4-0, but that series is tied 4-4 all-time!

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: And down in the basement, Tomfootballteam at GetBackGang. GetBackGang leads that series 1-0 and desperately needs to make it 2-0. Team Ayers also visits Northeast Winners, who lead that one 4-2.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Plus Team epps at Lorde Commish. Team epps leads 4-2. Commish, PLEASE check your tight ends this week.

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: Say whatttt hosts Lul Daddy too, and leads that series 2-0. Lul Daddy had a week off. Let's see if it helped.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: That's the show! I'm Big Mike Malone, and remember: if you're 0-4, the only way to go is up. Or further down. Mostly down.

lines.speaker: tasha
lines.text: I'm Tasha Reid. Set your lineups, check your kickers, and Commish, Hockenson is a tight end. He goes in the tight end slot.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: This has been BLOODSPORT CENTER! Good night!
